notes:
OCRelay 1.1.14

WHEN A SCAN COMES BACK BLANK, THE LOG NOW SAYS WHY

• A carotid run on 13 October opened the review panel with every field empty, four times running. The capture was correct and the AI answered normally — but nothing was written to the log, so there was no way to tell whether the AI had read the sheet and found nothing, or had not answered in a form OCRelay could use.

• Three different failures used to end the same silent way. They now each say so, and say which study it was: the AI read the worksheet and found nothing; the AI replied with words instead of values; or its reply was cut off part-way.

• What the AI said is recorded with the first two, shortened and with emails, tokens and identifier-shaped numbers removed first. Where the AI answered properly and simply read nothing, only the field names are recorded — there are no values to record.

• Nothing changes about what you see. This makes the next blank scan diagnosable from an exported diagnostics bundle instead of unanswerable.

A VALUE OF ZERO IS NO LONGER DROPPED

• A measurement of 0 was being treated as a missing value and discarded before it reached the review panel, whenever the AI returned it as a number rather than as text.

• Placental grade 0 is the real case — a legitimate grade that silently disappeared. Genuinely empty fields are still left alone.
